title: Testing React Applications
objectives: Master React Testing Library, user-event, and testing best practices.
theory_markdown: Test behaviour, not implementation. React Testing Library queries by role, label, and text — the way users interact. `user-event` simulates real user interactions. Mock API calls with MSW (Mock Service Worker). Test loading, error, and success states.

code_walkthrough.explanation: `screen.getByRole` queries accessible roles. `userEvent.setup()` provides realistic interactions. `waitFor` handles async rendering. MSW intercepts network requests at the service worker level.

ai_tool_spotlight.description: Use **Qodo Gen** (free VS Code extension) to generate tests for your components. Use **Cypress** or **Playwright** for E2E testing.
